question: On weave patches without holes: do bond polygons have weight exactly 3(m - 2); does the polygon search equal brute force; which pairs carry an excess of bond distance over steps apart + 1 at eleven and twelve knots, and how large; does any random patch to forty knots reach excess 3?

definitions.facing: lone, opposite classes, each in the other's wedge (DOUBLE-MEET)

forbidden_inputs: Changing cases, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
cheapest_meaningful_control: checks.py gates, including the referee's twelve-knot disc.

predictions.R1: Lemma P on every bond to nine knots
predictions.R2: polygon search = brute force on every pair to nine knots
predictions.R3: excess and unbonded pairs only lone opposite facing (11 and 12 knots)
predictions.R4: largest excess at 12 knots is exactly 2
predictions.R5: no excess >= 3 on random patches of 20-40 knots

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as scored by merge.py

stop_rule: One run; read-out; referee hand-off; report.
runtime: 8 workers through scripts/longrun.py (RIM-EXCESS-B1), about an hour
